title: Qaidi Bani Kari Hay, Karbal May Zahra Sani
body:
Bhulay gi kesay Zainab haye, Baad Az Nabi jo key
hay, Umat’ nay mehar bani
<<DIVIDER>>
1- Zahra bhi duwa daytin, Mola say ajar milta
Is kaam kay sadqay may, firdous may ghar milta
Karbal may musalamano haye, do ghount pila
daytay, Asghar ko agar pani
<<DIVIDER>>
2- Paband rasan Zainab, chadar bhi nahi sar pay
Toti hay qayamat wo, Zahra kay bharay ghar pay
Bazu bandhay huway hain haye, Haidar key bayteon
kay, haye shaam^ ko ravaney
<<DIVIDER>>
3- Karbal na gayi bibi, baythe hay Madinay main
Haye barchi lagi kaysay, tayray bhai kay seenay
main
Marjayegi Sughra tu haye, Zainab nay jub sunayi,
Akbar key ye kahani
<<DIVIDER>>
4- Matam namaz tayri, Qayam namaz kar lo
Zahra key duaon say, daman ko upnay bhar lo
Mola ka zikr karna haye, Zainab ko rona Akhtar
Momin key hay nishani
